title: sheltie settings
description: sheltie.json in the Herdr app home, or a repo's .sheltie.json (there only tracker, jira, github, branch and workflow apply). Merged over the defaults: set only what you change.

roots.description: Where your git repos are: folders `depth` levels below each root. ~ is your home folder.

depth.description: How many levels below each root your repos are.

programs.description: Programs, found on your login shell's PATH unless given as absolute paths. Each is needed only by what uses it.

jira.description: jira-cli, only with the Jira tracker.

sqlite3.description: Only once opencode has a database to read.

claude.description: For the Usage sidebar's plan limits.

tracker.description: Where tickets come from: "jira" (jira-cli) or "github" (GitHub issues, gh).

jql.description: Which tickets to list (jira-cli adds the ORDER BY). Naming `project` makes jira-cli search every project, not just its default one.
jql.default: project IS NOT EMPTY AND assignee = currentUser() AND resolution = Unresolved

transitions.description: Jira transitions at each step, or null for none.

resolution.description: Resolution set with the `done` transition, if its screen asks for one.

repos.description: Repos (owner/repo) to list issues from; empty: anywhere you can see.

assignee.description: List open issues assigned to this user ("@me": you).

ref.description: The issue's part of a branch name; {number} is the issue number.

closeOnFinish.description: Close the issue at Finish if merging its PR didn't already.

githubOwners.description: GitHub orgs/users searched for pull requests that mention a ticket, in addition to the owners of your local repos and of the repos in repoRules.

repoRules.description: Where new work on a ticket goes. Each rule matches a ticket by any of component, label or project (the Jira project key, or the issue's owner/repo) and names a repo: "owner/repo" on GitHub (cloned into the first root if needed) or a local path. Component and label rules win over project rules.

branch.description: A ticket's branch: {ref} is the tracker's part (WEB-142, issue-12), e.g. "me/{ref}".

worktreeDir.description: Where ticket worktrees go, relative to the repo's main checkout.

argv.description: The agent started in a ticket's space; its first message is the last argument (as with `claude "<task>"`).

task.description: First message for new work. {key}, {summary}, {url}, {branch} and {viewCommand} (how to read the ticket) are filled in.
task.default:
Work on {key}: {summary}

Run `{viewCommand}` for the description and comments. When the pull request is complete, run `hc label "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" pr=ready`.

extraBranchTask.description: First message when asking for another branch of a ticket in a repo that already has one: the agent names and creates it itself. Also {worktreeDir}.
extraBranchTask.default:
Start another piece of work for {key}: {summary}

Create a git worktree under {worktreeDir}/ in this repo on a new branch named {branch}-<short-description> (pick a short kebab-case description of the change), then work in it. Run `{viewCommand}` for the description and comments. When the pull request is complete, run `hc label "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" pr=ready`.

adhocTask.description: First message for ad-hoc work (not tied to a ticket) on {branch}; {description} is what you typed.
adhocTask.default:
{description}

This is ad-hoc work, not tied to a ticket: you're in a new worktree on branch {branch}. When the pull request is complete, run `hc label "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" pr=ready`.

steps.description: What each Work sidebar step sends to the agent.

agents.description: Whose session logs count toward the Usage sidebar and each Work row's cost: type, in home (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME, opencode's data folder).

prices.description: URL of a LiteLLM-format model price list (file:// works); downloaded when it changes, at most hourly.

autoMerge.description: At Ready: turn on auto-merge "when-reviews-required" (it then merges on approval and never at once), or "never" (merge with the Merge step).

readyWhen.description: When a draft PR is offered Ready: "green" (CI passed, no conflicts and nothing unresolved), or "agent" (also once its agent runs `hc label "$HC_TERMINAL_ID" pr=ready`).

mergeWithoutReview.description: Offer Merge for a ready, green PR that needs no review, not only for an approved one.

confirmMerge.description: Merge asks for a second click.

confirmFinish.description: Finish and Clean up ask for a second click.
